messages.content: I need to work out Denver for October 8 and 9. The partner dinner is Wednesday at 6:30 p.m., and I am moderating a panel Thursday from 9:00 to 10:15 a.m. I can leave Dallas Wednesday morning and come back after the panel. The organization gives me $800 total for airfare, one hotel night, and Denver transportation.
I can compare complete combinations. Is the dinner also near the Colorado Convention Center, and does the $800 exclude transportation between your home and the Dallas airport?
Yes, the dinner is at a restaurant about two blocks from the convention center. The allowance excludes my transportation at home, so only count Denver airport transfers and local travel there.

That helps. I found two workable flight patterns to compare. A Dallas Love Field itinerary is $356 round trip: Wednesday 8:40 a.m. to 9:45 a.m., then Thursday 3:10 p.m. to 6:10 p.m. A DFW itinerary is $298 round trip: Wednesday 9:25 a.m. to 10:35 a.m., then Thursday 2:05 p.m. to 5:07 p.m. Both are nonstop and the quoted totals include taxes. The earlier Thursday flight has a noticeably tighter airport transfer after your panel.
How tight? I do not need to stay around after the panel, but I will have to collect my bag from the hotel.

For the 2:05 p.m. DFW flight, I would target arrival at DEN by 12:05. If the panel ends on time at 10:15, allowing 15 minutes to exit and retrieve your bag leaves about 1 hour 35 minutes to reach the airport. A hired ride should take roughly 35 to 50 minutes in ordinary late-morning traffic, giving you about 45 to 60 minutes of cushion before the airport target. Rail takes longer once the walk or local connection to Union Station is included; a missed train could reduce the cushion to about 20 minutes.
So the 2:05 is possible by car but not comfortable by train. What are the hotel choices? I need somewhere I can walk to both events.

Two one-night options fit that area. Home2 Suites Denver Downtown Convention Center is about a five-minute walk from the convention center and is quoting $189 plus $30.24 tax, for $219.24 mandatory total. Hyatt Place Denver Downtown is about a four-minute walk and is $218 plus $34.88 tax, for $252.88 total. Both list Wi-Fi and Thursday luggage storage at no charge, but that storage should be reconfirmed for your departure date.
No breakfast or other amenities need to be part of the comparison. Give me the rail and car costs from the airport.

The RTD airport fare is currently estimated at $10 each travel day, so budget $20 round trip. From the airport, the A Line goes to Union Station; reaching either hotel then requires a walk of roughly 20 minutes or a short downtown connection. Hired rides are running about $40 to $55 each way before any unusual surge, so $90 round trip is a reasonable planning figure. Your dinner and panel would not require additional transportation from either hotel.
Build the totals both ways. Use Home2 first.

With Home2, the DFW flight and rail total $537.24: $298 airfare, $219.24 hotel, and $20 rail. Substituting hired rides brings that to about $607.24. The Love Field flight with rail totals $595.24, while the same flight with hired rides is about $665.24. All four remain under the $800 allowance; the hired-ride figures could vary with actual pricing.
And Hyatt Place would add $33.64 to each one, correct?
Correct. The Hyatt Place combinations are $570.88 for DFW plus rail, about $640.88 for DFW plus hired rides, $628.88 for Love Field plus rail, and about $698.88 for Love Field plus hired rides.
Compare the schedule margins on Wednesday too. I do not want the dinner to be the only thing I can make if a flight is delayed.

The Love Field flight reaches Denver at 9:45 a.m., leaving 8 hours 45 minutes before dinner. The DFW flight arrives at 10:35 a.m., leaving 7 hours 55 minutes. Even allowing an hour to deplane and travel by rail, both put you downtown around midday. A delay of two or three hours would still leave useful afternoon time before the 6:30 dinner. Love Field provides 50 minutes more protection, but neither Wednesday schedule is fragile.
Thursday matters more. If I take the 3:10 flight, lay out the rail timing after the 10:15 panel.

For a 3:10 p.m. departure, aim to be at DEN around 1:10. If you are out of the panel by 10:30 and have your stored bag by 10:45, you have 2 hours 25 minutes to reach the airport. Allowing about 20 minutes to Union Station, up to 30 minutes waiting for a train, and roughly 40 minutes on the A Line gets you to DEN around 12:15. That leaves about 55 minutes beyond the two-hour airport target. Even one missed train should still be manageable.
That is better. Is there any reason to pay for Hyatt Place over Home2 for this schedule?

Not from the facts that affect this trip. The walking difference is about a minute, both are positioned well for the dinner and panel, and both list complimentary luggage storage. Hyatt Place costs $33.64 more. Home2 is the stronger value unless its live rate has a restrictive cancellation term or Thursday storage cannot be confirmed.
Use Home2 and the Love Field flights, with rail as the planned transportation. I might use a car Thursday only if the panel runs late. What should I budget for that mixed case?

The selected baseline is $595.24. If you use the $10 rail fare Wednesday and a hired ride Thursday estimated at $45, the trip becomes about $630.24. Using the upper end of the Thursday ride estimate, $55, produces $640.24. That still leaves $159.76 under the allowance.
Does that include getting from Union Station to the hotel on Wednesday? I do not want a hidden local fare to break the comparison, even though there is plenty of room in the budget.

The $20 rail estimate assumes the airport fare covers your eligible RTD travel that day, including a connecting downtown bus if needed. If the fare product displayed at purchase does not include that connection, allow another $3 as a conservative local-transit contingency. That would make the baseline $598.24 or the mixed upper estimate $643.24.
Good. I am not asking you to book yet. Give me the exact option to price again and the checkpoints before I submit it.

Reprice the nonstop Love Field itinerary for October 8 at 8:40 a.m., arriving Denver at 9:45 a.m., and October 9 at 3:10 p.m., arriving back at 6:10 p.m.; the current round-trip total is $356 including taxes. Pair it with one night at Home2 Suites Denver Downtown Convention Center at a current mandatory total of $219.24. Plan on $20 for RTD airport travel, plus a $3 contingency if the downtown connection is not included, for a baseline of $595.24 to $598.24. Before paying, verify the flight times and nonstop status, the airfare total and any fare restrictions, and that the hotel total has no destination or facility fee. Confirm free Thursday luggage storage through at least 11:00 a.m., check the cancellation deadline, and verify the A Line service schedule for both travel windows. If the panel runs late, replace Thursday rail with a hired ride and keep $640.24 as the practical upper estimate, still $159.76 below the $800 allowance.
